label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: An EU redirect dialog opened over the page; after I closed it, an empty dialog shell named Modal Overlay [name] stayed in the tree, so it was unclear whether the page was blocked.
After choosing Continue the page main area was empty, with no loading status, so I could not tell whether anything happened and had to read again.
A discount email dialog with email and birth date fields appeared over the plan choice and has no close button; only Escape dismissed it. It came back after I picked a plan.

The plan buttons do not show which plan is selected, and the Book Bundles add-on is a checkbox inside a button and is already ticked, so an extra $20 per kit was added without my choice. Continue gave no feedback and I had to re-read to learn the cart had loaded.

findings.problem: The checkout page first showed only an empty main region and empty summary with no loading message. The newsletter checkbox is pre-ticked, the address field is a combobox with no hint, and shipping methods stay hidden until an address is entered.
